seo.title: $59 New Patient Special | Exam & X-Rays in Valencia
seo.description: New to Valencia Dentistry? Your first comprehensive exam and digital X-rays are $59. One-on-one care with Dr. Nuriel Lavi in Santa Clarita. Book today.

sections.heading: Your first exam and X-rays for $59.
sections.lead: A thorough, unhurried first visit with Dr. Nuriel Lavi: comprehensive exam, digital X-rays, oral cancer screening and a clear plan, with no pressure to proceed.

image.alt: Patient smiling during a dental cleaning

sections.heading: Everything a great first visit should have
sections.text: This is a real first appointment, not a quick look. You will leave knowing exactly where your oral health stands and what, if anything, needs attention.
bullets: Time for all of your questions
sections.fine: Offer for new patients without insurance, or in place of insurance benefits. Cleaning is scheduled separately once gum health is assessed. Cannot be combined with other offers.

sections.heading: Care you can feel the difference in

items.title: One dentist, every visit
